findings.title: reasoning_effort rejects "minimal", a value GPT-5 supports.
findings.body: The linked issue is about GPT-5, which accepts `reasoning_effort="minimal"`. The PR description also says `"minimal"` is supported, but both type definitions only allow `"low" | "medium" | "high"` (here and in the `CreateArguments` TypedDict at line 53). Loading a config with `"reasoning_effort": "minimal"` through `ChatCompletionClient.load_component` therefore fails Pydantic validation with a `ValidationError`. Passing it to the constructor directly fails type checking. Fix: change both to `Literal["minimal", "low", "medium", "high"]` and add `"minimal"` to the valid values in `test_reasoning_effort_validation`.
